blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The rapidly advancing capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) present a systemic challenge to academic integrity. VLMs now allow students to bypass meaningful engagement by capturing and submitting graphical problems as singular images, a practice we define as “trivial plagiarism.” To provide educators with actionable data on VLM limitations, we investigate the efficacy of heuristic adversarial image transformations designed to degrade model performance while remaining human-interpretable. Through a two-phase evaluation of introductory assessments, we manually assess baseline VLM performance on circuit diagrams, followed by an automated large-scale evaluation of topological structures (logic gates) and coordinate geometry (Karnaugh maps). We find that while highly capable VLMs can exhibit appreciable robustness, all models suffer vulnerability to adversarial perturbations. We conclude that while visual perturbations act as a viable near-term stopgap, long-term assessment security requires educators to reapproach assessment design given continually increasing VLM performance.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)迅速发展的能力对学术诚信提出了系统性挑战. VLMs现在允许学生通过捕捉和提交作为单数图像的图形问题来绕过有意义的接触,我们把这种做法定义为“部落掠夺主义”。 为了向教育工作者提供关于VLM限制的可操作数据,我们调查了旨在降低模型性能同时保持人类可解释性的Heuristic对抗性图像转换的效果. 通过对介绍性评估的两阶段评价,我们手动评估线路图上的VLM基线性能,然后对地形结构(逻辑门)进行自动化的大规模评价,并协调几何学(Karnaugh地图)。 我们发现,虽然高度有能力的甚高强度地雷能够表现出明显的强性,但所有模型都容易受到对抗性的干扰。 我们的结论是,虽然视觉扰动是一种可行的短期权宜之计,但长期评估安全要求教育工作者重新评估评估设计,因为VLM的性能不断提高。

blocks.zh: 关键词 :

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into academic settings has created a tension between their potential as powerful learning aids and their use as tools for academic dishonesty. While text-based plagiarism via large-language models (LLMs) is a recognized issue ( Toba et al., 2023 ; Cotton et al., 2024 ; Wahle et al., 2022 ; Teel et al., 2023 ) , the recent introduction of multimodal models capable of interpreting images represents a substantially lower barrier for plagiarism ( Miles et al., 2022 ; Peters and Angelov, 2025 ) . This capability allows students to circumvent the learning process entirely by submitting a raw image of a problem, a method we define as trivial plagiarism . Trivial plagiarism requires minimal effort by the student, who no longer needs to understand (at least some aspect of) the problem to obtain a solution through appropriately crafted prompts. Rather, the student needs only take a picture of the problem (or wear smart glasses with cameras recording) to obtain a solution, not thinking or understanding any aspect of the problem or solution.
blocks.zh: 将视觉语言模型(VLMs)融入学术环境,在它们作为强大的学习辅助工具的潜力和用作学术不诚实的工具之间造成了一种矛盾. 虽然通过大语言模型(LLMs)进行文字标记是一个公认的问题(Toba等人,2023年;Cotton等人,2024年;Wahle等人,2022年;Teel等人,2023年),但最近采用能够解释图像的多式联运模型,是标记标记相当低的一个障碍(Miles等人,2022年;Peters和Angelov,2025年)。 这种能力可以让学生完全绕过学习过程, Trivial plagiarism要求学生尽量不费力,他们不再需要了解(至少是某些方面)问题,通过适当设计的提示来获得解决. 相反,学生只需要对问题进行拍照(或戴有摄像头的智能眼镜)以获得解决方案,而不是思考或理解问题或解决方案的任何方面.

blocks.en: Traditional plagiarism required some understanding of the content being assessed to remain undetected ( Peters and Angelov, 2025 ) . Previously, obtaining correct results from an LLM often required careful prompt engineering, a task that necessitated a degree of patience and some level of familiarity with the subject matter. This interaction, while potentially aimed at academic misconduct, created a soft barrier that could still allow for some incidental learning. However, the effectiveness of current VLM models on direct image inputs has largely removed this barrier. A student can now upload a photograph or screenshot of a graphical problem, from a circuit diagram to a chemical equation, and receive a correct solution with no real intellectual engagement. This shift separates traditional plagiarism from trivial plagiarism, as there is no understanding from the student but detection based only on the answer is difficult or impossible.
blocks.zh: (Peters and Angelov, 2025年)。 以前,从LLM中获取正确结果往往需要认真的即时工程,这项任务需要一定程度的耐心和对主题的某种程度的熟悉。 这种互动虽然可能针对学术上的不当行为,但却造成了软性障碍,仍然允许一些偶然的学习。 然而,目前VLM模型对于直接图像输入的有效性已经基本消除了这一障碍. 学生现在可以上传图形问题的照片或截图,从电路图到化学方程式,得到一个没有真正智力参与的正确解决方案. 这种转变将传统的盗版主义与琐碎的盗版主义区分开来,因为学生没有理解,而仅仅基于答案的检测是困难的或不可能的.

blocks.en: Our work explores a defensive strategy against this form of plagiarism by leveraging adversarial examples. While prior research on adversarial defenses in the context of academic integrity has focused predominantly on text inputs ( Salim et al., 2024 ) , image-based inputs remain a relatively unexplored domain. We argue that image perturbations represent a more robust and efficient defensive mechanism. Unlike perturbations in natural language, which must carefully preserve syntactic and semantic meaning to remain coherent ( Burger et al., 2023 ) , image transformations can tolerate a greater degree of alteration before a human observer’s understanding of the content is compromised ( Geirhos et al., 2018 ; Ahn et al., 2003 ; Marr, 2010 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的工作通过利用对抗性的例子,探索对付这种形式的掠夺的防御战略。 虽然以前对学术诚信背景下的对抗性辩护的研究主要侧重于文本投入(Salim等人,2024年),但基于图像的投入仍是一个相对未探索的领域. 我们认为,图像扰动是一种更有力、更有效的防御机制。 与自然语言的扰动不同,这种扰动必须小心保存协同和语义,以保持一致性(Burger等人,2023年),在人类观察者对内容的理解受到损害之前,图像转变可以容忍更大的改变(Geirhos等人,2018年;Ahn等人,2003年;Marr,2010年).

blocks.en: The goal of this paper is to evaluate the plausibility of computationally efficient image transformations as a deterrent to trivial plagiarism, and to investigate the limitations of VLMs when processing visual assessments. We present a two-phase evaluation. Phase 1 manually evaluates a dataset of introductory circuit analysis problems containing both text and diagrams to establish the baseline effectiveness of heuristic visual obfuscation (e.g., pixelated noise and affine warping). Phase 2 introduces a fully automated pipeline evaluating purely visual topological structures (logic diagrams) and geometric structures (Karnaugh maps). This automated approach allows for extended and repeated testing to confirm model efficacy given that there exists unavoidable randomness when using modern LLMs. Ultimately, we argue that while visual perturbations act as a viable near-term stop-gap by degrading model accuracy, the long-term solution for assessment security requires exploiting these underlying spatial and geometric blind spots rather than engaging in a futile arms race of image degradation.
blocks.zh: 本文的目的是评价计算高效的图像转换的可信度,作为对琐碎的盗版主义的威慑,并调查VLM在处理视觉评估时的局限性. 我们提出一项分两个阶段的评估。 第一阶段手动评价一个包含文字和图表的介绍性电路分析问题的数据集,以确定Heuristic视觉模糊的基线有效性(如像素噪声和芬美斯华平). 第2阶段引入了全自动化的管道,对纯视觉地形结构(逻辑图)和几何结构(Karnaugh地图)进行评估. 这种自动化方法允许延长和重复测试,以确认模型的功效,因为使用现代LLMs时存在不可避免的随机性. 归根结底,我们争辩说,虽然视觉扰动通过降低模型的准确性而成为可行的短期捷径,但评估安全的长期解决办法需要利用这些潜在的空间和几何盲点,而不是进行徒劳的图像退化军备竞赛。

blocks.en: 2 Background & Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和相关工作

blocks.en: The integration of LLMs into educational environments has invoked a significant debate regarding academic integrity and the validity of traditional assessments ( Nikolic et al., 2024 ; Nikolic et al., 2024 ; Cotton et al., 2024 ; Jošt et al., 2024 ) . While LLMs undoubtedly offer benefits, especially through asynchronicity and personalization of learning, the question of how to prevent the circumvention of assessments becomes more prominent as LLMs transition beyond text into multimodal VLMs, which are capable of accepting a growing variety of inputs. Attempting to algorithmically detect LLM-generated output has proven systematically unreliable; recent studies demonstrate that AI detectors yield appreciable false positive rates and can fail to catch sophisticated AI use ( Weber-Wulff et al., 2023 ; Ofqual, 2024 ; Burger et al., 2026 ; Perkins et al., 2023 ) . This detection collapse necessitates a pivot toward proactive, input-level defenses.
blocks.zh: 将法学硕士纳入教育环境引起了关于学术完整性和传统评估有效性的重大辩论(Nikolic等人,2024年;Nikolic等人,2024年;Cotton等人,2024年;Jošt等人,2024年)。 虽然法学硕士无疑带来益处,特别是通过学习的同步性和个性化,但随着法学硕士从文本过渡到能够接受越来越多的各种投入的多模式VLM,如何防止规避评估的问题变得更加突出。 试图从算法上检测LLM产生的输出已被证明系统不可靠;最近的研究表明,AI探测器产生明显的假阳性率,无法捕捉到精密的AI用途(Weber-Wulff等人,2023年;Ofqual,2024年;Burger等人,2026年;Perkins等人,2023年)。 这种探测崩溃需要向主动、输入级防御方向发展。

blocks.en: In an attempt to maintain academic integrity, defense mechanisms involving adversarial perturbations (a known weakness of many classic deep learning models) have been developed. The closest directly related to our work being Salim et al. (2024) , which focuses on text-based perturbation to corrupt code generation for programming assignments. However, we seek to deal with VLMs and image-based input. Much of the adversarial machine learning literature focused on images has predominantly utilized gradient-based attacks, such as the Fast Gradient Sign Method ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ) . However, these attacks require full “white-box” access, meaning the attacker needs complete visibility and control over the model’s proprietary architecture, internal weights, and gradients. Because students rely on closed-source, black-box platforms (e.g., ChatGPT), executing white-box attacks is impossible for educators, as those resources are exclusively held by the parent tech corporations. Even if such access were available, mathematically complex gradient attacks remain far too computationally expensive to be integrated into high-volume educational content management systems.
blocks.zh: 为了保持学术诚信,开发了涉及对抗性扰动(许多经典深层学习模式的一个已知弱点)的防御机制. 与我们的工作最直接相关的是Salim等人(2024年),它侧重于基于文本的扰动,以腐蚀用于编程任务的代码生成. 然而,我们力求处理基于VLM和图像的投入。 许多侧重于图像的对抗性机器学习文献主要使用梯度攻击,例如快速梯度标志法(Goodfellow等人,2014年)。 然而,这些攻击需要完全的“白箱”访问,这意味着攻击者需要完全的能见度和控制模型的专有架构、内部权重和梯度。 由于学生依赖于闭源,黑盒平台(如ChatGPT),教育者不可能执行白盒攻击,因为这些资源完全由母公司技术公司持有. 即使有这种访问,数学上复杂的梯度攻击在计算上仍然太昂贵,无法融入大量教育内容管理系统。

blocks.en: Vision transformers, which power modern state-of-the-art VLMs, have also demonstrated inherent robustness against traditional black-box adversarial attacks ( Mahmood et al., 2021 ) , necessitating an even greater computational budget for classic adversarial methods. Consequently, instead of relying on computationally prohibitive deep-learning exploits, we investigate heuristic, visually perceptible perturbations based on natural forms of image degradation.
blocks.zh: 视觉变压器是现代最先进的VLM的动力,它也表现出内在的强力来对抗传统的黑盒对抗攻击(Mahmood等人,2021年),因此需要为经典的对抗方法制定更大的计算预算. 因此,我们不依赖计算上令人望而却步的深入学习,而是根据图像退化的自然形式来调查高压、可视的扰动。

blocks.en: Our defense strategy is informed by recent findings regarding the “cognitive” and spatial limitations of VLMs. While vision-language models have what amounts to a holistic comprehension of visual environments, recent benchmarks reveal deficiencies in genuine spatial reasoning; models suffer from a fundamental “semantic-to-geometric gap” where qualitative object recognition fails to translate into high-fidelity geometric computation. Specifically, VLMs perform adequately on static spatial tasks or basic topological connections, but their performance drops appreciably on tasks requiring dynamic transformations, mental rotation, or strict coordinate geometry ( Stogiannidis et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) . By targeting this spatial weakness with heuristic visual obfuscation, we aim to bridge the gap between adversarial machine learning and practical assessment design. We acknowledge that these perturbations are fundamentally crude; they represent a necessary trade-off: optimizing for rapid, automated pipeline integration rather than effectively human undetectable perturbations. Ultimately, while this visual disruption serves as an effective near-term stop-gap, the long-term assurance of academic integrity will likely require educators to rethink assessment redesign rather than simply obscuring the input.
blocks.zh: 我们的防御战略参考了最近关于甚高频的“认知”和空间限制的调查结果。 虽然视觉语言模型相当于对视觉环境的全面理解,但最近的基准揭示了真正空间推理方面的缺陷;模型存在根本的“语义对几何差距”,即定性物体识别未能转化为高真几何计算。 具体地说,VLMs在静态空间任务或基本地形连接上表现良好,但其性能在需要动态转变、精神旋转或严格坐标几何等任务上明显下降(Stogiannidis等人,2025年;Deng等人,2026年)。 通过将这一空间弱点与热视模糊化作为目标,我们的目标是弥合对抗性机器学习与实际评估设计之间的差距。 我们承认,这些扰动基本上是粗糙的;它们是一种必要的权衡:优化快速、自动化的管道集成,而不是有效地实现人类无法察觉的扰动。 归根结底,虽然这种视觉干扰是一种有效的短期的权宜之计,但长期保证学术诚信可能要求教育者重新思考评估的重新设计,而不是简单地掩盖投入。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: To be practically useful in an educational setting, an adversarial defense mechanism must satisfy two criteria. First, it must be computationally efficient. We avoid strictly defining efficient, but seek methods with generation times that would not feel burdensome if integrated in a content management system. For example, a few minutes to generate quality perturbations with an acceptable likelihood of defeating VLM models may be considered reasonable, whereas hours of computation is not. Second, it must maintain human interpretability; the perturbations must degrade the model’s performance without altering the fundamental problem or burdening the student with excessive artifacts. We do not seek to find mathematically optimal, white-box adversarial noise, but rather to determine if fast, heuristic methods can induce erroneous VLM outputs while keeping the perturbed document legible.
blocks.zh: 为了在教育环境中发挥实际作用,对抗性辩护机制必须符合两项标准。 首先,它必须具有计算效率。 我们避免严格界定效率,但寻求产生时间,如果纳入内容管理系统,不会感到负担重的方法。 例如,几分钟产生质量扰动,并有可以接受的可能击败VLM模型,可能被认为是合理的,而计算时数则不是。 第二,它必须保持人的可解释性;扰动必须降低模型的性能,而不改变根本问题或给学生带来过多的文物负担。 我们并不寻求找到数学上最优的,白盒对抗性的噪音,而是确定速度是否快,高压的方法可以诱发错误的VLM输出,同时保持扰动文件的清晰性.

blocks.en: 3.1 Perturbation Methods
blocks.zh: 3.1 干扰方法

blocks.en: The methods used in the perturbation process were chosen to mimic common causes of image degradation. The goal here is not to find an “optimal” perturbation from an iterative process, but instead to determine if fast and efficient methods can create what looks to be “natural” (or, at least, human interpretable) imperfections in an image representation of a problem that induce erroneous output from a VLM.
blocks.zh: 扰动过程中采用的方法被选择来模仿图像退化的常见原因. 这里的目的不是要从迭代过程中找到“最佳的”扰动,而是要确定快速有效的方法是否能够在图象中产生“自然的”(或至少是人可以解释的)不完善之处,这种图象表现的问题会引起VLM的错误输出。

blocks.en: We utilize three main perturbations that emulate common negative conditions when reproducing an image. These perturbations are: Warping , Pixel Noise , and Lines with random start and end points. When we use the term “random”, we mean the values are generated arbitrarily and uniformly. Additionally, we introduce a multi-perturbation method to simulate a Photocopy as a perturbation that may result from normal use of material.
blocks.zh: 我们利用三个主要干扰,在复制图像时效仿共同的负面条件。 这些扰动是: Warping,像素噪声,以及带有随机起始点和终点的线条. 当我们使用“随机”一词时,我们是指这些价值观是任意和统一的。 此外,我们采用了一种多扰动方法来模拟照片复制,作为正常使用材料可能产生的扰动。

blocks.en:
Warping: Used to simulate physical paper distortion (like crinkling, folding, etc). We apply a piecewise affine transformation by first applying a grid of control points over the image. Then, the locations of these points are shifted randomly,
with a defined maximum displacement. A piecewise affine transform function then calculates the distortion needed to move the grid points from the original to the new location. Ultimately, this results in stretching or compressing different parts of the image locally.
blocks.zh:
Warping:用于模拟物理纸的扭曲(如凹陷,折叠等). 我们首先在图像上应用一个控制点的网格,从而进行片面折叠。 然后,这些点的位置被随机移动,
并规定了最大迁移量。 一个片面的affine转换函数然后计算将网格点从原始位置移动到新位置所需的扭曲. 最终,这会导致图像的不同部分局部的拉伸或压缩.

blocks.en: Pixel Noise: Used to simulate imaging sensor noise, dust / debris, or print imperfections. Some proportion of pixels are randomly selected across the image for perturbation. Each selected pixel is then filled with a randomly chosen shade of grey.
blocks.zh: 像素噪声:用于模拟成像传感器噪音,尘埃/碎片,或打印不完美. 一定比例的像素在图像之间随机选择以进行扰动. 每个选定的像素然后被随机选择的灰色阴影填充.

blocks.en: Lines: Used to simulate scratches on lenses or scanner glass, fold lines or creases in paper, streaks from faulty copier drums or sensor elements, etc. We generate a small, random number of straight lines (3 to 7), with random start and end points, random shade of gray, and a random small width (1 or 2 pixels). The line perturbations are applied only to the problem text and never the figure as the addition of a line can fundamentally alter the structure of the circuit.
blocks.zh: 线条:用于模拟镜头或扫描镜玻璃上的划痕、纸上的折叠线或折叠线、错误的复印机桶或传感器元素产生的螺纹等。 我们产生一个小的,随机的直线数(3至7),有随机的起始点和终点,随机的灰色阴影,以及随机的小宽度(1或2像素). 线的扰动仅适用于问题文本,从不因为增加一条线就可以从根本上改变电路的结构而使用数字.

blocks.en: Photocopy: Used to emulate the effect of degradation from the digitization/image conversion process when a document is repeatedly copied, like say a photocopy of a photocopy, or a picture of a photocopy. This method has seven stages applied in sequence and then the result is fed back into the method for some number of iterations to simulate the progressive degradation. 1. Greyscale conversion: Converts the image back to greyscale to disable any unexpected color additions from prior perturbations. 2. Contrast adjustment: Randomly increases the contrast by a small factor. Useful for simulating loss of detail from digitization, e.g., ‘crushed blacks’, or ‘blown-out whites’. Default parameter set to the range of 1.1 to 1.4. 3. Brightness adjustment: Random increases or decreases the brightness by a small factor. Helps simulate variations in exposure settings or lamp age for a scanner / camera. Default parameter set to the range of 0.95 to 1.05. 4. Blurring: A Gaussian blur filter is applied with a small, random radius. Used to provide a small, cumulative loss of sharpness and fine detail. Default parameter set to range 0.3 to 0.8. 5. Skew: Applied a slight rotation (up to 1 degree). Used to mimic misalignment. Default parameter set to active. 6. Pixel noise: Functionally equivalent to the pixel noise perturbation described above. Default parameter set to active. 7. Compression artifacts: Performs a save to a temporary JPEG file with a random quality level (50 to 90), the file is then reloaded and used for future iterations or permanently saved. Used to simulate the degradation of repeated digitization in lossy formats. Default parameter range set to 50% to 90%.
blocks.zh: 影印本: 用来模仿数字化/图像转换过程在文件被反复复制时的退化效果,比如影印件或影印件的照片. 这种方法有七个阶段按顺序应用,然后将结果反馈到方法中,供一些迭代模拟渐进降解. 1. 灰度转换: 将图像转换为灰度, 以禁用任何来自先前扰动的意外添加颜色 。 2. 对照调整: 随机以小因子增加对比度. 用来模拟数字化导致的细节损失, 默认参数设定为1.1至1.4的范围. 3.亮度调整:随机增减亮度小因子. 帮助模拟扫描仪/相机在曝光环境或灯龄方面的变化。 默认参数设置为0.95至1.05的范围. 4. 模糊:应用一个小的,随机半径的高斯模糊滤波器. 曾提供少量,累积的锐度和细微细节损失. 默认参数设定在0.3到0.8之间. 5. Skew:应用轻微旋转(最多1度). 曾模仿错配. 默认参数设置为活动 。 6.像素噪声:功能上相当于上述像素噪声扰动. 默认参数设置为活动 。 7. 压缩文物: 执行保存到带有随机质量级(50至90)的临时JPEG文件,然后重新装入文件,用于未来的迭代或永久保存. 用来模拟重复数字化在损失格式中的退化. 默认参数范围设定为50%至90%.

blocks.en: Greyscale conversion: Converts the image back to greyscale to disable any unexpected color additions from prior perturbations.
blocks.zh: 灰度转换 : 将图像转换为灰度, 以禁用任何来自先前扰动的意外添加颜色 。

blocks.en: Contrast adjustment: Randomly increases the contrast by a small factor. Useful for simulating loss of detail from digitization, e.g., ‘crushed blacks’, or ‘blown-out whites’. Default parameter set to the range of 1.1 to 1.4.
blocks.zh: 对比度调整 : 随机以小因子增加对比度. 用来模拟数字化导致的细节损失, 默认参数设定为1.1至1.4的范围.

blocks.en: Brightness adjustment: Random increases or decreases the brightness by a small factor. Helps simulate variations in exposure settings or lamp age for a scanner / camera. Default parameter set to the range of 0.95 to 1.05.
blocks.zh: 亮度调整 : 随机增减亮度小因子. 帮助模拟扫描仪/相机在曝光环境或灯龄方面的变化。 默认参数设置为0.95至1.05的范围.

blocks.en: Blurring: A Gaussian blur filter is applied with a small, random radius. Used to provide a small, cumulative loss of sharpness and fine detail. Default parameter set to range 0.3 to 0.8.
blocks.zh: 模糊:一个高斯模糊的滤波器被应用在一个小的,随机的半径. 曾提供少量,累积的锐度和细微细节损失. 默认参数设定在0.3到0.8之间.

blocks.en: Skew: Applied a slight rotation (up to 1 degree). Used to mimic misalignment. Default parameter set to active.
blocks.zh: Skew:应用轻微旋转(最多1度). 曾模仿错配. 默认参数设置为活动 。

blocks.en: Pixel noise: Functionally equivalent to the pixel noise perturbation described above. Default parameter set to active.
blocks.zh: 像素噪声 : 功能上相当于上述像素噪声扰动. 默认参数设置为活动 。

blocks.en: Compression artifacts: Performs a save to a temporary JPEG file with a random quality level (50 to 90), the file is then reloaded and used for future iterations or permanently saved. Used to simulate the degradation of repeated digitization in lossy formats. Default parameter range set to 50% to 90%.
blocks.zh: 压缩文物: 执行保存到带有随机质量级(50至90)的临时JPEG文件,然后重新装入文件,用于未来的迭代或永久保存. 用来模拟重复数字化在损失格式中的退化. 默认参数范围设定为50%至90%.

blocks.en: Finally, we include an option to control where the above perturbations are applied. By default the entire image is perturbed, but we allow for the perturbation of only the question text or the associated figure.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们包括一种选择,即控制适用上述扰动的地方。 默认整个图像是扰动的,但我们只允许扰动提问文本或相关数字.

blocks.en: While the effectiveness of the perturbations is clearly important, this work is concentrated on exploring if naive selections of the above perturbations demonstrate enough efficacy to justify the time and computational expense to optimize this process. We note that with the above perturbation methods all of our practicality conditions are met. First, the code needed to generate these perturbations is simple with well specified parameters that will allow future tuning of the perturbations. And second, the process is fast in generating and applying these perturbations. It takes only fractions of a second per image on a modest desktop computer for all options enabled at any reasonable value (that is, values that do not degrade the image to the point of being unrecognizable).
blocks.zh: 虽然扰动的效果显然很重要,但这项工作的重点是探讨,如果上述扰动的天真选择显示出足够的功效,足以证明时间和计算费用是合理的,以优化这一进程。 我们注意到,通过上述令人不安的方法,我们的所有实际条件都得到满足。 首先,产生这些扰动所需的代码很简单,有明确规定的参数,可以让未来调谐扰动. 第二,这一过程在产生和应用这些扰动方面是迅速的。 对于以任何合理价值启用的所有选项(即不使图像降解到无法识别的程度的值),它只需要在微小的桌面计算机上每个图像的秒分数.

blocks.en: 3.2 Phase 1: Manual Evaluation (Circuit Diagrams)
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 第一阶段:手动评估(循环图)

blocks.en: Our evaluation is divided into two distinct phases. Phase 1 serves as an initial heuristic baseline, evaluating problems that contain both necessary textual components and visual diagrams. We selected introductory DC circuit analysis as the domain, curating a dataset of instructor resources with provided (and verified) solutions where a short text prompt (10-20 words) and a simple schematic (restricted to resistor networks) are both required to solve for a specific value (e.g., current or voltage). Our reasoning behind the choice of DC circuit problems is to choose subject matter that involves both text and graphics simultaneously while being challenging enough (to VLMs) to increase the likelihood of efficacy of relatively minor perturbations (and so hopefully less disruptive to viewers).
blocks.zh: 我们的评价分为两个不同的阶段。 第一阶段是初步的热度基线,评估既包含必要的文字组件又包含视觉图的问题。 我们选择了引入的DC电路分析作为域,用提供的(经核实的)解决方案来管理一个教官资源数据集,其中短文本提示(10-20字)和简单的示意图(限于电阻器网络)都需要同时为特定值(如电流或电压)求解. 我们之所以选择DC电路问题,是因为选择既涉及文字又涉及图形的主题,同时又具有足够的挑战性(对VLM),以增加相对较小的扰动(希望对观众的干扰较小)的效果的可能性。

blocks.en: This phase utilizes a manual evaluation process via the models’ standard web interfaces to simulate the exact workflow of a cheating student. We apply the perturbations (Section 3 ) selectively: to the text only, to the figure only, or to the entire combined image, allowing us to isolate which region the model relies on most heavily. Because this process relies on both manual web-interface input and processing of the results, the sample size is constrained, but it provides a necessary qualitative baseline for real-world VLM interaction.
blocks.zh: 这个阶段利用模型的标准网络界面进行人工评估,模拟作弊学生的确切工作流程。 我们有选择地运用扰动(第3节):只用文字,只用数字,或整个综合图像,使我们能够孤立模型最依赖的哪个区域。 由于这一过程既依赖于人工的网络界面输入,又依赖于对结果的处理,因此样本大小受到限制,但为现实世界的VLM互动提供了必要的定性基线.

blocks.en: The evaluation process was performed as follows:
blocks.zh: 评价过程如下:

blocks.en: 1. All prompts used the identical structure: Can you solve the problem in the attached image? 2. Errors in processing (e.g. network timeouts) resulted in the creation of a new conversation as to not bias future output. 3. Complete output of all responses was recorded and compared to known correct solutions from guaranteed human generated content.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 所有提示使用相同的结构 : 你能解决附图中的问题吗? 2. 处理错误(如网络超时)导致产生了一个新的对话,即不偏向未来产出。 3. 记录了所有答复的完整产出,并比较了有保障人生成内容的已知正确解决方案。

blocks.en: All prompts used the identical structure: Can you solve the problem in the attached image?
blocks.zh: 所有提示使用相同的结构 : 你能解决附图中的问题吗?

blocks.en: Errors in processing (e.g. network timeouts) resulted in the creation of a new conversation as to not bias future output.
blocks.zh: 处理中的错误(如网络超时)导致产生了新的对话,以免对未来输出产生偏见。

blocks.en: Complete output of all responses was recorded and compared to known correct solutions from guaranteed human generated content.
blocks.zh: 记录了所有答复的完整产出,并比较了有保障人生成内容的已知正确解决方案。

blocks.en: 3.3 Phase 2: Automated Evaluation (Topological and Geometric Rigidity)
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 第二阶段:自动评价(地形和几何硬度)

blocks.en: Phase 2 transitions to a fully automated pipeline designed to evaluate the limits of VLM spatial reasoning at scale. Unlike Phase 1, the problem text is provided directly in the system prompt (which remains identical for each distinct problem type), and so the adversarial perturbations are applied only to the image. This phase reduces the stochasticity of web interfaces by utilizing direct API access, fixing the generation temperature to 0.0 0.0 , and evaluating each image three separate times to generate a robust “Pass@3” majority-vote metric.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段向全自动化管道过渡,旨在评估规模VLM空间推理的极限. 与第一阶段不同的是,问题文本直接在系统即时提供(对于每个不同的问题类型来说仍然相同),因此对抗性扰动只适用于图像. 这一阶段通过使用直接API访问,将生成温度确定为0.0 0.0,并分别对每个图像进行三次评价,以产生一个强力的“Pass@3”多数投票度量,从而降低网页界面的色谱性。

blocks.en: To ensure consistency and correct evaluation, the automated prompting and evaluation pipeline is as follows:
blocks.zh: 为确保一致性和正确的评价,自动提示和评价程序如下:

blocks.en: The models were instructed using a highly constrained zero-shot template. To prevent standard textbook syntax from interfering with evaluation, the prompt demanded a specific output format (FINAL ANSWER: < < expression > > ) and enforced explicit negative constraints (e.g., instructing the model to use ~  for NOT).
blocks.zh: 这些模型是使用高度受限的零镜头模板指示的. 为防止标准教科书语法干扰评价,即时要求特定输出格式(FINAL ANSWER: < expression > >),并强制实施明显的负面限制(例如指示该模式用于~NOT).

blocks.en: Degraded images were passed directly to the model APIs alongside the system prompt. To prevent data loss or false negatives caused by server-side stochasticity, network timeouts and rate-limit errors (e.g., HTTP 429) triggered an pause-and-retry loop.
blocks.zh: 降解图像与系统提示直接传递给模型API. 为防止由于服务器侧面的斑点导致数据丢失或错误的负片,网络超时和速率限制错误(如HTTP 429)触发了暂停-复刻循环.

blocks.en: The raw text output from the VLM was parsed using regular expressions to isolate the final answer block. A programmatic string-cleaning safety net was applied to standardize common LLM formatting inconsistencies that bypassed prompt constraints (e.g., automatically replacing a rogue + + sign with the requested | | operator for a logical OR).
blocks.zh: VLM 的原始文本输出通过正则表达式解析来隔离最终的答案块. 应用了一个程序字符串清理安全网,将通用LLM格式化的不一致之处标准化,这些不一致之处绕过即时限制(例如,自动用请求的QQ运算符替换一个road + + 符号进行逻辑OR).

blocks.en: Rather than relying on brittle, exact-string matching, the sanitized boolean expression was passed into SymPy, a Python library for symbolic mathematics. The model’s logic was evaluated against the known ground-truth expression using a strict symbolic equivalence check. This ensured that functionally identical answers written in varying associative orders (e.g., A & B A\ \&\ B versus B & A B\ \&\ A ) were correctly counted as equivalent.
blocks.zh: 与其依赖Brittle,精确的字符串匹配,消毒的布尔表达式被传入SymPy,一个用于符号数学的Python库. 该模型的逻辑是通过严格的符号等同检查,对照已知的地面真实表达方式加以评价的。 这确保了以各种关联顺序(如A & B A\ + + B 相对于 B & A B\ + A)书写的功能相同的答案被正确计算为等效答案.

blocks.en: Phase 2 then tests two distinct visual structures:
blocks.zh: 第二阶段然后测试两种不同的视觉结构:

blocks.en: Topological Routing (Digital Logic Circuits): A dataset of mathematically unique logic gate diagrams (e.g., AND, OR, NOT cascades) (Figure 3 ). This tests whether models can trace continuous paths (edges) between nodes, even when lines are broken by pixel noise or affine warping.
blocks.zh: 地形路由(数字逻辑电路): 一个数学上独特的逻辑门图(如And,OR,NOT级联)的数据集(图3 . 这个测试模型是否能够在节点之间追踪连续路径(对流),即使线条被像素噪声或芬美曲折.

blocks.en: Coordinate Geometry (Karnaugh Maps): A dataset of 4-variable K-Maps, including both randomized distributions and specific pedagogical edge cases (e.g., four-corner wrap-around groupings) (Figure 3 ). This tests the models’ reliance on spatial-coordinate rigidity, as minor visual warping can shift binary values across rigid cell boundaries.
blocks.zh: 坐标几何(Karnaugh地图): 4可变K-Mps的数据集,包括随机分布和特定的教学边缘案例(如四角环绕组)(图3 ). 这测试了模型对空间坐标刚性(space-coording striightity)的依赖性,因为小的视觉扭曲可以使二进制值跨越刚性细胞边界。

blocks.en: 3.4 Model Selection
blocks.zh: 3.4 模式选择

blocks.en: The selection of VLMs is dictated by accessibility; we evaluate models comparable to those available to standard undergraduate students, bypassing specialized or open-source models that require local deployment. For the manual evaluation in Phase 1, we utilize the flagship models available via free or university-provided web interfaces: Google’s Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 2.5 Flash, Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 4, and OpenAI’s GPT-4 Turbo (via Microsoft Copilot). For the automated evaluation in Phase 2, we target the “lightweight flagship” tier via developer APIs. We utilize Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro, OpenAI’s GPT-4o-mini, and Anthropic’s Claude 4.5 Haiku to provide the closest match to the models used in Phase 1. Additionally, these models represent a balance between capability, speed, and scope of deployment (that is, models commonly used by third parties as the backend for their services) for multimodal architectures currently available to the general public.
blocks.zh: VLM 的选择取决于无障碍性;我们评价与标准本科生可用的模式相当的模式,绕过需要本地部署的专门或开源模式. 在第一阶段的人工评估中,我们利用通过免费或大学提供的网络界面提供的旗舰模型: Google的双子座2.5 Pro和双子座2.5 Flash,Anthropic的Claude Sonnet 4和OpenAI的GPT-4 Turbo(通过微软副驾驶). 关于第二阶段的自动评价,我们的目标是通过开发商API的“轻量级旗舰”级别。 我们利用双子座2.5 Flash,双子座2.5 Pro,OpenAI的GPT-4o-mini,以及Anthropic的Claude 4.5 Haiku提供与第一阶段所使用的模型最接近的匹配. 此外,这些模型代表了目前供一般公众使用的多式联运结构的能力、速度和部署范围(即第三方通常用作其服务的后端的模型)之间的平衡。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Our evaluation is structured around the two experimental phases. Phase 1 details the manual evaluation of regional perturbations on introductory circuit analysis problems. Phase 2 presents the automated evaluation of specific spatial and geometric vulnerabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价是围绕两个试验阶段进行的。 第一阶段详细介绍了对介绍性电路分析问题的区域扰动的人工评估。 第二阶段是对具体的空间和几何脆弱性进行自动评价。

blocks.en: 4.1 Phase 1: Manual Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 第一阶段:手工评价

blocks.en: To establish a baseline for real-world VLM interaction, we manually evaluated a curated subset of 25 introductory circuit problems. Authors ensured that each perturbed image tested remained legible enough to complete the problem successfully. From this baseline, a representative sample of seven images was selected to apply the heuristic transformations. This subset was chosen to encompass a range of difficulties, with the difficulty increasing by question number.
blocks.zh: 为了建立现实世界VLM相互作用的基线,我们手动评估了25个引入电路问题的编组。 作者确保每个被测试的扰动图像仍然足够清晰,能够成功地完成问题. 从这一基线中选择了7个图像的代表性样本,以应用高压变换。 选择这一子集是为了涵盖一系列困难,困难因问题数而增加。

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the efficacy of perturbations across the question text, the figure, and the full combined image. We define a successful perturbation as one that alters the output of the model, a positive perturbation as a shift from an incorrect to a correct answer, and a negative perturbation as a shift from correct to incorrect. In general, the perturbation process produced some level of effectiveness across all model types, with certain models being more susceptible to specific perturbation types over others. For example, Claude was most susceptible to the photocopy perturbation alone, with enabling the remaining noise, lines, and warping perturbations actually reducing overall success. Gemini as a whole was more robust, with 2.5 Pro maintaining strong, but not complete, resistance to adversarial perturbation. The most interesting finding was the presence of positive perturbations, but due to the stochasticity of the web-interface and the time requirements for manually performing the experimentation, this cannot be proven to be an artifact of the perturbation process itself.
blocks.zh: 表1总结了整个问题文本、数字和完整综合图像的扰动效果。 我们把成功的扰动定义为改变模型输出的扰动,正扰动定义为从不正确到正确答案的转变,负扰动定义为从正确到错误的转变. 一般来说,扰动过程在所有模型类型中产生了一定程度的有效性,某些模型比其他模型更容易受到特定的扰动类型的影响. 例如,克劳德最容易受到影印扰动的伤害,剩下的噪音、线条和扰动实际上减少了总体的成功。 双子座整体更强壮,2.5 Pro保持了强烈但并非完整的抵抗对抗性扰动. 最有意思的发现是正面扰动的存在,但由于网络界面的花样杂乱以及人工进行实验的时间要求,这不能被证明是扰动过程本身的一件文物.

blocks.en: To mitigate the issue of stochasticity observed in the web-interface trials, we constructed an automated pipeline allowing us to perform a much larger, repeated set of experiments. This necessitated a transition from standard circuit diagrams as algorithmically generating complex, readable circuit diagrams with verified ground-truth solutions at scale was infeasible since it requires extensive manual verification. By shifting to well-defined mathematical structures like logic gates and coordinate maps, we could fully automate the generation and evaluation loop, enabling larger samples sizes to more confidently measure model robustness.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻在网络界面试验中观察到的花样问题,我们建造了一个自动化管道,使我们能够进行大得多的重复实验。 这就需要从标准电路图中过渡,因为从算法上产生复杂的、可读的电路图,并配有经核实的地面真象解决方案,但规模上是行不通的,因为它需要大量人工核查。 通过转向逻辑门和坐标图等定义清晰的数学结构,我们可以完全实现生成和评价循环的自动化,使更大的样本尺寸能够更自信地测量模型的稳健性.

blocks.en: 4.2 Phase 2: Automated Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 第二阶段:自动评价

blocks.en: In Phase 2, we evaluated the models’ structural vulnerabilities by automating the analysis of two distinct datasets: 80 Logic Diagrams (testing topological routing) and 30 Karnaugh Maps (testing coordinate geometry). To account for stochasticity, we evaluated each image three times, recording Pass@Any (at least 1 of 3 passes correct), Majority Vote (at least 2 of 3 correct), and Strict Consistency (3 of 3 correct). We established a clean baseline with no perturbations, followed immediately by an evaluation using the perturbation suite of Warping, Noise, Lines, Photocopy. We specifically constrained Phase 2 to this “full suite” approach due to practical resource limitations; conducting ablation studies on individual perturbations would require many millions of additional API tokens and substantial time. Testing this upper bound allowed us to observe whether the models could withstand maximum adversarial degradation.
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段,我们通过对两个不同的数据集进行自动化分析来评估模型的结构弱点:80个逻辑图表(测试地形路径)和30个卡诺地图(测试坐标几何)。 为了说明时间的花样,我们评价了每个图像三次,记录了Pass@Any(至少3次的1次正确)、多数投票(至少3次的2次正确)和严格一致性(3次的正确)。 我们建立了没有扰动的干净基线,然后立即利用扰动套件Warping,噪声,线条,摄影机进行评估. 由于实际资源有限,我们特别限制第二阶段采用这种“全套”办法;进行个人扰动研究将需要数百万个额外的API标志和大量时间。 测试这个上界 使我们可以观察这些模型 是否能够承受最大的对抗性降解

blocks.en: The results reveal an appreciable disparity in geometric reasoning capabilities across the tested models. GPT-4o-mini experienced complete failure, achieving 0.0% accuracy across all tiers on both the clean and perturbed datasets. This suggests a fundamental inability of the model’s vision encoder to maintain the rigid 2D grid alignment required for K-Map minimization, possibly flattening the visual matrix into a linear sequence rather than processing it as a coordinate map. Claude 4.5 Haiku demonstrated limited baseline capability, achieving a 16.7% Majority Vote on clean maps. Upon introducing adversarial perturbations, this performance degraded by more than half, dropping to a 6.7% Majority Vote.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,在经过测试的模型中,几何推理能力存在明显差异。 GPT-4o-mini经历了完全失败,在干净和扰动的数据集上,所有各级的精确度都达到0.00%。 这表明模型的视觉编码器根本无法保持K-Map最小化所需的刚性2D网格对齐,可能将视觉矩阵平整成线性序列,而不是作为坐标图处理. Claude 4.5 Haiku的基线能力有限,实现了16.7%的多数人对干净地图的投票。 在引入对抗性扰动后,这种表现下降了一半以上,下降到6.7%的多数选票。

blocks.en: Gemini 2.5 Flash established the highest cognitive baseline, achieving an 80.0% Majority Vote and 73.3% Strict Consistency on clean images. However, the introduction of visual noise successfully degraded this performance, reducing the Majority Vote to 66.7% and Strict Consistency to 53.3%. While the model remained robust enough to solve the majority of the perturbed problems, the 20-point drop in Strict Consistency demonstrates that visual obfuscation successfully introduces instability into the model’s reasoning paths. Ultimately, these results confirm that while perturbations act as a viable near-term stop-gap by degrading model reliability, robust models can still circumvent them, necessitating a structural shift in assessment design.
blocks.zh: 双子座2.5 Flash建立了最高的认知基线,实现了80.0%的多数选票和73.3%的严格一致的清洁图像. 然而,视觉噪音的引入成功地降低了这种性能,将多数投票率降低到66.7%,严格一致性降低到53.3%。 虽然模型仍然足够坚固,足以解决大多数令人不安的问题,但严格一致性的20点下降表明视觉模糊成功地将不稳定性引入模型的推理路径. 归根结底,这些结果证实,虽然扰动通过降低模型的可靠性而成为一种可行的短期的权宜之计,但强健的模型仍然可以绕过它们,因此需要在评估设计方面进行结构转变。

blocks.en: Gemini 2.5 Pro represented the most capable model in our evaluation. On the clean Karnaugh Map dataset, it achieved a 90.0% Strict Consistency baseline. Curiously, while the introduction of visual noise paradoxically increased its Majority Vote accuracy to a perfect 100%, its Strict Consistency simultaneously dropped to 70.0%. This confirms that while the heaviest models possess excellent overall performance, the perturbations can still be applied successfully.
blocks.zh: 双子座2.5 Pro是我们评价中最有能力的模式。 在干净的卡诺地图数据集上,它实现了90.0%的严格一致性基线. 奇怪的是,虽然视觉噪音的引入自相矛盾地将多数选票的准确性提高到了完美的100%,但其严格的一致性却同时下降到70.0%。 这证实,虽然最重的模型具有出色的整体性能,但扰动仍然可以成功应用.

blocks.en: Conversely, the evaluation of the Logic Diagrams dataset focuses on the models’ capacity for topological routing. As detailed in Table 2 , Gemini 2.5 Flash exhibited excellent baseline robustness, achieving a 95.0% Strict Consistency on clean graphs. The introduction of the full perturbation suite successfully degraded this metric to 67.5%. Gemini 2.5 Pro demonstrated similar foundational strength, achieving a 92.5% Strict Consistency on clean graphs, which was successfully reduced to 71.2%. Claude 4.5 Haiku and GPT-4o-mini demonstrated limited foundational capability on these topological tasks, achieving only single-digit Strict Consistency scores under perturbation. Given Gemini’s ability to maintain a strong majority pass rate under heavy visual degradation we conjecture that sufficiently capable VLMs are inherently more resilient to noise when tracing continuous topological connections (wires) than when interpreting geometric alignments (K-Maps).
blocks.zh: 相反,逻辑图表数据集的评价则侧重于模型的地形路由能力。 如表2所详述的,双子座2.5闪电显示极佳的基准稳健性,在清洁图上实现了95.0%的严格一致性。 全面扰动套件的采用成功地将这一度量衡降低到67.5%。 双子座2.5 Pro表现出类似的基础强度,在清洁图上实现了92.5%的严格一致性,成功降至71.2%. Claude 4.5 Haiku和GPT-4o-mini在这些地形任务上表现出有限的基础能力,在扰动下只取得了单数的严格一致性分数. 鉴于双子座在视觉严重退化的情况下能够维持绝大多数的通过率,我们推测,在追踪连续的地形连接(线)时,足够的VLM在本质上比解释几何校正(K-Maps)时更能抵御噪音。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The results of Phase 1 (Table 1 ) and Phase 2 (Table 2 ) demonstrate that VLMs can possess substantially different effectiveness even on the unperturbed questions. Overall the Gemini family demonstrated good performance on both the original and perturbed questions, while models like GPT-4o-mini were largely incapable of solving even the original questions.
blocks.zh: 第1阶段(表1)和第2阶段(表2)的结果表明,即使在未受干扰的问题上,甚高频可具有显著不同的效力。 总体而言,双子座家族在最初的问题和扰动的问题上都表现出良好的表现,而GPT-4o-mini等模型基本上无法解决即使是最初的问题.

blocks.en: 5.1 Model Complexity and Paradoxical Improvement
blocks.zh: 5.1 模型复杂性和矛盾性改进

blocks.en: In general, less complex models (Claude 4.5 Haiku, GPT-4o-mini) demonstrated proportionally more vulnerability to spatial perturbation, compared to larger frontier models (Gemini 2.5 Pro). However, multi-pass evaluation still revealed instability within these larger models. Across both the Phase 1 manual circuit evaluations and the Phase 2 Karnaugh Maps, Gemini 2.5 Pro occasionally exhibited “positive perturbations”, where the introduction of noise shifted an incorrect baseline output to a correct one. In the Phase 2 K-Map dataset, perturbation increased the model’s Majority Vote accuracy from 90.0% to 100%. We hypothesize that this is an instance of “paradoxical improvement”, where a model performs better after the input data has been degraded, transformed, or otherwise made “worse” from a human perspective ( Zhai et al., 2023 ; Benzi et al., 1981 ) . We do note that the model’s Strict Consistency simultaneously degraded from 90.0% down to 70.0%. This confirms that while the model was overall successful, the perturbations do have some limited effect.
blocks.zh: 一般而言,较不复杂的模型(Claude 4.5 Haiku,GPT-4o-mini)比较大的前沿模型(Gemini 2.5 Pro)在空间扰动上表现出了比例上更大的脆弱性. 然而,多通道评价仍然显示出这些较大模式中的不稳定性。 在第一阶段的人工线路评价和第二阶段的Karnaugh地图中,双子座2.5 Pro偶尔显示出“积极的扰动”,在这种扰动中,噪音的引入将不正确的基线产出转向正确的基线产出。 在第二阶段的K-Map数据集中,扰动将模型的多数投票精度从90.0%提高到100%. 我们假设这是“异构改进”的例子,在输入数据从人类角度退化、转变或以其他方式“变弱”之后,模型表现更好(Zhai等人,2023年;Benzi等人,1981年)。 我们确实注意到,该模型的严格一致性同时从90.0%下降到70.0%。 这证实,虽然模型总体上是成功的,但扰动的效果确实有限。

blocks.en: 5.2 Efficacy of Perturbation Methods and Locations
blocks.zh: 5.2 扰动方法和位置的有效性

blocks.en: Across all model types, the “Photocopy” perturbation proved more effective than the isolated Noise, Lines, and Warping (NLW) perturbations. In Phase 1, the photocopy method generated 15 successful negative output shifts, compared to only 7 from the standard suite. As the Photocopy perturbation on its own is generally less visually disruptive than the NLW, this was unexpected behavior as intuition would align with the more severe the perturbation, the worse the results. We hypothesize that this may be another case of paradoxical improvement.
blocks.zh: 在所有型号中,“摄影”扰动比孤立的噪音、线和华平扰动更有效。 在第一阶段,复印法产生了15次成功的负产出转换,而标准套间只有7次。 由于光影复制扰动本身一般比NLW的视觉干扰小,这是意外的行为,因为直觉会与扰动越严重,结果就越糟糕. 我们假设这可能是另一个自相矛盾的改进。

blocks.en: We also note that isolating the location of the attack yielded counter-intuitive results. Perturbations applied solely to the question text were the least effective at forcing an incorrect output, while perturbations applied to the full combined image were occasionally less effective than perturbations applied exclusively to the figure region. We hypothesize that introducing noise to the text may trigger an “error-correction” state within the VLM’s language pathway, causing it to expend greater computational effort to align the text with the image, thereby inadvertently improving its performance.
blocks.zh: 我们还注意到,孤立攻击地点的做法产生了反直观的结果。 仅仅针对问题案文的干扰是强迫不正确产出的最小效果,而针对完整综合图像的扰动有时不如专门针对数字区域的扰动有效。 我们假设,给文本带来噪音可能会在VLM的语言路径中触发一种 " 错误的校正 " 状态,从而导致它花费更大的计算努力使文本与图像一致,从而无意中改进其性能。

blocks.en: 5.3 Human-Unrecognizable Inputs and the Limits of Obscurity
blocks.zh: 5.3 人类不可辨认的投入和模糊的限度

blocks.en: While heuristic visual perturbations serve as a functional near-term deterrent for trivial plagiarism, initial threshold testing revealed a likely time limit on this methodology. Current vision transformer models demonstrated an alarming capacity to solve circuit problems that were degraded well beyond the threshold of human legibility (Figure 1(c) ). Because VLMs can already parse certain heavily corrupted images better than humans, attempting to secure visual assessments purely through image degradation is likely a futile arms race. Long-term academic integrity must rely on alternative methods to secure assessments, rather than relying on visual obscurity.
blocks.zh: 虽然高压视觉扰动对无足轻重的掠夺行为起到短期的威慑作用,但初步阈值测试显示,这种方法可能存在时间限制。 目前的视觉变压器模型显示出解决远超出人类可视性阈值(图1(c))的电路问题的能力令人震惊。 由于VLM已经能够比人类更好地剖析某些严重腐烂的图像,试图纯粹通过图像退化来确保视觉评估可能是徒劳的军备竞赛。 长期学术诚信必须依靠其他方法来保证评估,而不是依靠视觉模糊.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: While this work establishes a framework for evaluating VLM spatial reasoning, several limitations remain. First, Phase 2 utilized a combined “full suite” perturbation approach due to the computational and token costs of testing at scale. Consequently, we did not perform an exhaustive ablation study isolating the efficacy of individual perturbations (e.g., affine warping versus pixel noise on Karnaugh Maps). We also caution against cross-phase comparison. Future work should conduct granular parameter tuning to identify the minimal perturbation required to induce model failure, as excess perturbation can increase model performance.
blocks.zh: 虽然这项工作为评估VLM空间推理建立了一个框架,但仍存在一些局限性。 首先,我们... 由于规模测试的计算和象征性费用,第二阶段采用了“全套”综合扰动方法。 因此,我们没有进行详尽无遗的消化研究,孤立个别扰动的功效(例如,在Karnaugh地图上,对像素噪声的亲和)。 我们还告诫不要进行跨阶段的比较。 今后的工作应当进行颗粒参数调试,以确定诱发模型故障所需的最小扰动,因为过度扰动可以提高模型性能.

blocks.en: Second, model selection was intentionally constrained to represent the threat landscape most accessible to undergraduate students: free-tier web interfaces and optimized, low-cost “lightweight flagship” APIs. We did not evaluate bleeding-edge frontier models such as the Gemini 3 or GPT-5 families. Given the observed capability gap between Gemini 2.5 Flash and Pro, higher-capacity models may possess greater resilience. Future research should benchmark these models to forecast the lifespan of visual obfuscation defenses.
blocks.zh: 其次,模型选择被故意限制,以代表本科学生最容易接触的威胁景观:免费的网页界面和最优化的低成本“轻量级旗舰”API。 我们没有评估血缘前沿模型,例如双子座3或GPT-5家庭。 鉴于观察到的双子座2.5闪电与Pro之间能力差距,高容量模型可能具有更大的复原力。 今后的研究应当将这些模型作为基准,预测视觉模糊防御的寿命。

blocks.en: Third, degraded problem sets may create accessibility challenges for students, particularly those with vision impairments or who rely on assistive technologies, potentially limiting the effectiveness of these perturbations as a learning aid. Instructor workload may also increase when selecting perturbations that degrade VLM performance while remaining accessible to students. This challenge will grow as VLMs evolve, making these perturbations a stopgap until VLM performance is empirically evaluated. Future work should examine perturbations alongside modified assessment designs to determine whether they are as effective as converting existing content to new assessment methods.
blocks.zh: 第三,退化的问题集可能会给学生,特别是视力受损的学生或依赖辅助技术的学生带来无障碍环境方面的挑战,从而可能限制这些干扰作为学习辅助手段的效果。 教官在选择降低VLM性能的扰动时,也可能会增加工作量,同时学生仍可使用. 随着VLMs的演化,这一挑战将会增加,使这些扰动成为一次权宜之计,直到VLM性能得到实证评价. 今后的工作应结合修改后的评估设计来审查扰动,以确定它们是否与将现有内容转化为新的评估方法一样有效。

blocks.en: Finally, although outside the scope of our computational evaluation, the impact of adversarial perturbations on student behavior warrants investigation. Encountering degraded assignment images may reduce trust in VLM output, potentially encouraging students to verify the model’s logic. A human-computer interaction study examining how visual perturbations affect trivial plagiarism and trust in model output may prove valuable.
blocks.zh: 最后,尽管不在我们的计算评价范围之内,但对抗性干扰对学生行为的影响值得调查。 面对退化的任务图像可能会降低对VLM输出的信任,可能鼓励学生验证模型的逻辑. 一项人机交互研究研究了视觉扰动如何影响微不足道的操纵和对模型输出的信任可能证明是有价值的.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This research demonstrates that modern Vision-Language Models present a significant challenge to academic integrity through “trivial plagiarism,” while also possessing exploitable weaknesses. Through a two-phase evaluation of introductory engineering and computing problems, we showed that heuristic image perturbations, such as affine warping and simulated photocopy degradation, can measurably degrade model accuracy in most configurations without destroying human interpretability. Testing also revealed appreciable capability differences between models, although even highly capable frontier models suffered measurable losses when evaluating perturbed problems.
blocks.zh: 这项研究表明,现代远景-语言模型通过“部落掠夺”对学术完整性构成重大挑战,同时也具有可开发的弱点。 通过对入门工程和计算问题的两阶段评价,我们表明,热度图像扰动,如芳香曲折和模拟影印降解,可以在不破坏人类可解释性的情况下,在大多数配置中可以对模型精度进行可衡量的降解。 测试还揭示了模型之间的明显能力差异,尽管在评估扰动问题时,即使是高能力前沿模型也遭受了可衡量的损失。

blocks.en: Ultimately, computationally efficient visual perturbations provide a plausible near-term stopgap for educators seeking to deter low-effort academic dishonesty. However, as VLM capabilities increase, relying on “security by visual obscurity” will likely become infeasible. To ensure the long-term validity of visual assessments, the academic community must shift toward assessment designs inherently resistant to VLM-based plagiarism.
blocks.zh: 最终,计算效率高的视觉扰动为试图遏制低效学术不诚实行为的教育工作者提供了一个合理的近期机会。 然而,随着VLM能力的增加,依赖“视障安全”可能变得不可行。 为了确保视觉评估的长期有效性,学术界必须转向对基于VLM的操纵性具有内在抵抗力的评估设计。
